pcs.pc_description: analyze the work requirements by interacting with the supervisor
plan to visit customer premises to understand the installation position of air conditioner such as window, split, high, low, etc
check that the location meets structural requirements such as distance from power supply, distance from windows/doors being opened frequently
inform customer about any pre installations/masonry/electrical work to be carried out
mark position for placement of indoor/outdoor units to get customer confirmation on position and installation on next visit
remove the air conditioner packaging without causing any damage and ensure that it matches the customer order in terms of colour and make
check that all supporting accessories are available in the pack
inspect that tools and fitments required for the installation are available
dispose off the packaging material waste as per company’s norms
measure the location to drill holes ensuring that no internal wiring damage takes place
Install using smart tools (digital manifold gauges, vacuum pumps with Bluetooth), inverter ACs, window AC and Split AC
place the outdoor unit at a suitable location and attach it firmly to wall/floor
connect the indoor and the outdoor units using the field copper pipe of appropriate size and interconnecting cables
fill in additional gas if the distance between the indoor and the outdoor units is more than what is recommended
align the air conditioner as per the instructions manual and make necessary power supply connections
demonstrate the features/utility to customer for the new installation while explaining the precautions to be taken while using the air conditioner

modules.module_title: Analyze symptoms, identify and rectify faults

pcs.pc_description: analyze usage pattern of the air conditioner from the customer
diagnose the fault based on customer interaction and initial inspection by carrying out basic tests such as power supply inspection,volt ampere test, etc.
separate and inspect every module of the unit if the fault is not identified through basic tests
plan to send air conditioner to factory for in- depth diagnosis, if problem cannot be identified at site
repair or replace faulty part as per requirement at customer location or send it to service center on time in case immediate repair is not possible for specialized parts such as PCB
plan second visit to replace dysfunctional module/part after collecting it from service center
carry out brazing operation at the customer premise or pass the complaint on to a specialist in- charge of handling brazing, if the fault identified is a gas leak
reassemble the unit after rectifying identified fault
check that all the modules of the unit work as per specifications and confirm functionality to the customer
collect necessary payment from the customer as per rate sheet/ communication from customer care and provide the receipt
fill in customer acknowledgement form and seek customer’s signature
complete documentation for recording installation/repair of air conditioner and update the company ERP software for tracking/future references
inform customer care and supervisor about job completion
